results.summary_before: This project implements a frequency sweeper in Verilog that generates an output clock whose frequency is divided by 2 every 15 clock cycles, cycling from 1/2 to 1/16 of the input clock frequency. It has an active-high enable input and a single clock output. The design includes a testbench and Python script for simulation, and for hardware testing, an oscilloscope is needed to observe the output. It is a simple clock generation experiment.
